giver: An operator who has been told the system is automated and has never counted.
object: List every action the operator of some running system can take, and sort them into start, stop, and adjust-mid-run.
done: You have a count, and a verdict: automated if the third pile is empty, assisted if it is not.
note: Both verdicts are fine. Assisted is a good design. The failure is calling one the other.
